title: Gender-Based Pricing in Consumer Packaged Goods: A Pink Tax?
authors: Sarah Moshary; Anna E. Tuchman; Natasha Vajravelu
eligible_reason: Pink-tax study: cross-sectional comparisons of prices of women's versus men's personal-care products (women_flag, a fixed product attribute) with store, year, manufacturer and module FE. No treatment adoption or DiD; footnote 27 'stacked regression' pools categories, not a stacked DiD.
design_notes: analysis/code/01_Descriptives-and-Estimation.R: feols(log price ~ women_flag (+ product_vol) | store_code_uc + year (+ manufacturer FE)).
data_files_note: NielsenIQ (Kilts), Syndigo and Label Insight data not shipped; simulated_data illustrates structure and does not merge to Nielsen.
data_provenance_note: Licensed data not shipped; only simulated attribute files.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
